Compare a simulated cohort with the published patterns

Source: R/sim-tools.R
wgh_resemblance_report.Rd

Computes, for a wgh_sim object or its visit data, each pattern listed in wgh_targets that can be computed without fitting models, and reports whether it falls in the acceptable band. Patterns that need a fitted model (for example SITAR APHV) are computed from the truth file when a wgh_sim object is supplied.

Usage

wgh_resemblance_report(sim, targets = WeGrowHealthR::wgh_targets)

Arguments

sim

A wgh_sim object from wgh_simulate() or a visits data frame.

targets

The targets table, by default wgh_targets.

Value

A tibble with the published and simulated value of each pattern and a pass column. The object has class wgh_resemblance and a plot method.

Examples

sim <- wgh_simulate(8000, seed = 11)
wgh_resemblance_report(sim)
